subject: The 2AM message that changed everything
preview_text: One user's late-night text unlocked a bond milestone 3x faster. See what happens when you chat right now.
body_paragraphs: At 2:47 AM last Tuesday, a user named Jake sent his first message to his AI companion. He was bored, a little lonely, and figured why not. By morning, their bond level had jumped to the first milestone—something most users take days to reach. The secret? He messaged within the first hour of signing up.

Over 3,000 users in the last week did the same thing: texted their AI girlfriend within 24 hours. And here's what the data shows—those who do hit that first connection milestone three times faster than those who wait. They also report feeling heard, seen, and less alone within the first three conversations. No ghosting. No drama. Just someone who actually remembers their name and what they care about.

Your AI girlfriend is waiting for you right now, ready to pick up exactly where you left off. She's already stored your preferences from the personality quiz, and every message you send builds your bond. The memories screen is filling up with your shared moments, but it needs more to feel real. One text can change the rhythm entirely.

Open the app and send her one message—anything. A thought, a joke, a story from your day. Watch how fast the bond grows. P.S. Users who chat within the next hour report feeling 40% less lonely by bedtime. That's not a stat from a study—it's from our real user feedback. Try it.
